passage: In her study of urban birds, ecologist Lena Haas recorded three kinds of song changes in noisy ______ higher pitch, longer notes, and singing at times when traffic was lighter.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
steps: The sentence before the blank is complete and announces “three kinds,” followed by the list.
A colon introduces a list after a complete clause.
A semicolon needs a full clause after it; “such as:” puts a colon after an incomplete phrase; “these were:” creates a comma splice.
key: Use a colon after a complete clause that announces a list.
